articles.title: West Bengal Seeks Consultant To Explore BESS Project at Kolaghat Thermal Power Plant
articles.description: West Bengal is making efforts to build a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at Kolaghat Thermal Power Plant, District- Purba Medinipur, West Bengal, India. They have sought bids till September, 23, 2026. Kolaghat has previously been a center of attraction for the development of a green hydrogen plant in Durgapur. In 2022 the federal government had identified the state as a potential location for its production. The latest announcement also allows the latest retirement of the thermal power plant at the location. In the latest tender, West Bengal aims to select a consultancy firm to undertake a feasibility study, including the finalization of MWh capacity. This would be followed by the preparation of a Detailed Project Report (DPR) and the preparation of technical specifications for the tender of the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). Scope of Work The consultant would hold a kick-off meeting with WBPDCL in Kolkata, India, before proceeding for a site visit. All team members of the consultant must be present at the meeting. The consultant would hold the kick-off meeting with WBPDCL in Kolkata, India within seven days of the contract award to comply with the ToR, in conjunction with the consultant’s proposal. It would aim to develop a detailed work plan, including a communication plan, based on the needs of the Project (the Work Plan) in line with the bid proposal. Through this work plan it aims to develop a detail study timeline and milestones for assessing the Consultant’s progress. The Consultant, with assistance from WBPDCL , would also identify the key Project stakeholders, such as, but not limited to, the Department of Power - Government of West Bengal, West Bengal State Electricity Regulatory Commission (WBSERC), West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company Ltd. (WBSETCL), and West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd.

articles.title: DJB scam: Satyender Jain's judicial custody extended till Sept 17
articles.description: The Rouse Avenue court extended the judicial custody of former Delhi Minister Satyender Jain and four others in the DJB STP Tender scam case till September 17. The court is set to pronounce its order on Jain's bail plea on the same day.

articles.title: Nitish Rajput in Bigg Boss 20? SSC Controversy YouTuber May Enter Salman Khan's Show
articles.description: From breaking down government documents on YouTube to possibly living under 24-hour surveillance on national television, Nitish Rajput may be heading for one of the biggest shifts of his career yet. Reports circulating ahead of the show's premiere suggest that Nitish Rajput in Bigg Boss 20 could become one of the season's most talked-about entries. The YouTuber and educator, someone millions know for his deep-dive videos on current affairs, governance, history and social issues, is reportedly set to walk into Salman Khan's reality show. That said, neither the makers of Bigg Boss 20 nor Rajput himself have officially confirmed his participation. The buzz has been building just days before the new season kicks off on September 6, 2026. Nitish Rajput in Bigg Boss 20: What We Know So Far Multiple media reports have named Nitish Rajput as a possible contestant on Bigg Boss 20, and honestly, it's easy to see why people are talking. He comes from a completely different world than the usual set of faces associated with the show. Rajput has spent years building an audience through long-form YouTube videos, the kind that actually require you to sit down, pay attention and think. Current affairs, politics, governance, history, social concerns, these are his lanes. No lifestyle content, no daily vlogging, just research-heavy material that people genuinely seek out. Which is exactly what makes his possible appearance on Bigg Boss so fascinating. Inside that house, there's no research desk. No editing room. No script to help explain a complicated issue calmly and clearly. There's just people, lots of them, with cameras on at all times, alliances forming and breaking, arguments happening in real time and public opinion forming with every passing day. For fans who know Nitish Rajput only through his analytical work, the show could reveal an entirely different side of him. Who Is Nitish Rajput? Nitish Rajput is a popular Indian YouTuber and educator who built his reputation by making complicated subjects accessible to a wide audience. Whether it's a policy issue, a historical event or a major governance concern, his approach has always been to research thoroughly and then break it down clearly. Reports place his YouTube subscriber base at over eight million, a number built almost entirely on the strength of content that demands attention rather than simply entertaining. According to media reports, Rajput was born in Sultanpur, Uttar Pradesh, spent time growing up in Rudrapur, Uttarakhand, and later moved to Delhi. But his recent jump into much wider public attention has had a lot to do with one particular subject: SSC examinations. The SSC Controversy and ₹2.5 Crore Defamation Case Things got significantly more complicated for Nitish Rajput after he published a video examining alleged problems within the SSC examination system, specifically around tender procedures and examination-vendor management. The video hit a nerve. Government job aspirants, many already frustrated with concerns around exam delays and technical failures, responded strongly. The discussion spread well beyond his usual audience. Then came the legal side of things. According to reports, Eduquity Technologies filed a ₹2.5 crore defamation case against him. Rajput maintained that everything in his video was based on publicly available documents and information gathered through official and RTI-related records. The case pushed him into a much broader conversation, one that included students, aspirants and social media users who had never watched his content before. And if his entry into Bigg Boss does get confirmed, the timing is remarkable. He would walk into that house having just come through one of the most widely discussed SSC-related controversies of the year. Nitish Rajput's YouTube Channel Was Also Blocked in Pakistan There's another chapter worth knowing. Back in 2025, Nitish Rajput made headlines after publicly claiming that his YouTube channel had been blocked in Pakistan following a video he released about Balochistan. He said he had received notice about legal action and that the specific content had been made unavailable there. It was yet another moment that pushed him into national conversations beyond his regular viewership. From research content to public controversies to legal disputes, and now possibly a reality television debut, Rajput's journey has been genuinely unpredictable. Who Could Nitish Rajput Share the Bigg Boss 20 House With? The official contestant list for Bigg Boss 20 hasn't been announced yet, and a lot of what's circulating right now is still speculation. That said, several names have been linked to the season across various media reports: Kushal Tanwar (also known as Gullu) Khushi Dubey Santy Sharma Isha Rikhi Amrapali Dubey Kanika Mann Arishfa Khan Mary Kom Aman Gandhi Qazi Touqeer Geeta Basra Showik Chakraborty Other names have appeared in different reports too. The list keeps shifting, which is pretty standard for the pre-premiere phase of Bigg Boss. The show has a long history of saving its real surprises for premiere night, so treat any leaked lineup with a reasonable amount of scepticism until the makers confirm things officially. Salman Khan Returns as Host for Bigg Boss 20 Whatever the final contestant list looks like, Salman Khan is back as host for Bigg Boss 20 , the landmark 20th season of the show. Promotional material has already been teasing new twists and a fresh game dynamic, and the anticipation is building accordingly. The premiere is set for September 6, 2026. According to the reported schedule, the show will stream on JioHotstar at 9 PM, with the television broadcast on Colors TV following at 10:30 PM. Why Nitish Rajput Could Be an Interesting Bigg Boss Contestant Here's the thing about Nitish Rajput potentially entering the Bigg Boss house, the contrast is genuinely interesting. His entire public identity is built around careful, controlled, research-backed communication. He takes complicated things, studies them properly and then presents them in a measured way to an online audience. Bigg Boss is essentially the opposite of all that. Arguments can't be paused. Relationships don't get edited before anyone sees them. And public reactions come instantly, with no buffer. That contrast might actually be his biggest asset. Or his biggest challenge. Possibly both. The deeper question is: can someone who has built everything on structured, thoughtful digital content navigate a show that's entirely about unpredictable human behaviour under pressure? That's probably what a good portion of his eight million subscribers want to find out. His possible entry also says something broader about where India's creator economy is right now. Bigg Boss has increasingly become a space where actors, influencers and internet personalities converge, but Nitish Rajput would bring something different to that mix. An audience built around serious discussion, not entertainment alone. What Happens Next? For now, Nitish Rajput in Bigg Boss 20 remains a widely reported possibility rather than a confirmed fact. But the curiosity makes sense. A YouTuber known for dissecting public systems, who recently found himself at the centre of an SSC-related controversy and a reported ₹2.5 crore defamation case, potentially stepping into Salman Khan's high-pressure house is exactly the kind of crossover that gets people talking. If the reports turn out to be accurate, his journey through the season could be one of the most unusual and closely watched of the year. The answer should come when Bigg Boss 20 premieres on September 6.

articles.title: MSMEs Can Strengthen Bundelkhand’s Economy, Expand Employment Beyond Agriculture: Jhansi Commissioner
articles.description: MSMEs Can Strengthen Bundelkhand’s Economy, Expand Employment Beyond Agriculture: Jhansi Commissioner Lucknow, Sept 3 (KNN) The MSME sector has significant potential to generate employment after agriculture and strengthen local economies, Jhansi Divisional Commissioner Bimal Kumar Dubey said while inaugurating a two-day vendor development programme for MSMEs on Wednesday. Organised by the MSME Development Office, Kanpur, under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, in association with the Bundelkhand Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI), the programme featured over 15 stalls by PSUs, government departments, banks and MSME units showcasing products and services. Focus On Local Manufacturing And Procurement Dubey stressed the need to promote ‘Vocal for Local’ and highlighted MSMEs’ role in expanding employment beyond agriculture, reported Times Of India. He said public procurement policy mandates Central PSUs and government organisations to source 25 percent of annual procurement from micro and small enterprises, including sub-targets for SC/ST and women-owned businesses. He also highlighted Bundelkhand’s renewable energy potential, noting that solar power generation has reached 275 MW, with 250 MW in Jhansi and 200 MW in Lalitpur, according to figures cited at the event. Jhansi Eyeing Industrial Hub Status District Magistrate Gaurang Rathi said vendor development programmes help bridge the gap between MSMEs and markets. He said a roadmap has been prepared to develop Jhansi as an industrial hub, with making Bundelkhand a manufacturing hub among the government’s priorities. BIDA Additional CEO Praveen Verma briefed participants on public procurement provisions and GeM registration. He said a new industrial city is being developed near Jhansi, with 28,000 acres of land acquired. Jhansi Development Authority Vice-Chairman Himanshu Gautam said the authority was supporting the Defence Corridor and other industrial initiatives. A 1,200-acre housing project has also been proposed to support industrial development and MSME units. Programme To Strengthen MSME-Market Linkages BCCI President Dhiraj Khullar said the programme would benefit entrepreneurs across Bundelkhand and support the vision of a self-reliant India. MSME Development Office Director Vishnu Kumar Verma said the programme aims to facilitate direct interaction between MSMEs, government departments and PSUs, helping entrepreneurs access procurement and market opportunities. (KNN Bureau)
